source.name: flights
source.selection: January 2024. Keep every row in the source CSV order. Select 9 fields. Parse integer times and floating delays; retain nulls. Derive the airport-city lookup from distinct origin pairs.
source.workloads: Custom udfx workloads on public data, not upstream compiler coverage.

arrival_delay: double
